title: startup probe with empty prefix produces /_stoa_write_probe not documented
description: WebDavStore passes prefix='' to startup_probe, which formats '/_stoa_write_probe' → OPath normalizes to '_stoa_write_probe'. This is correct and tested but the interaction between empty string prefix and OPath normalization is non-obvious. A future contributor might be tempted to change this to Some('blocks') or None. Should add a comment in webdav_store.rs explaining that the URL is the collection root, no additional prefix subdirectory is used, and that the startup probe lands at <url>/_stoa_write_probe.
